paragraphs: AirDNA sells short-term rental market data built from Airbnb and Vrbo listings, covering more than 15 million properties across 120,000 global markets. The buyers range from a first-time host to a large enterprise.

The company describes its analytics tools as delivering precise insights that help a customer make informed decisions. The tools are pitched on ease of use and on insights a customer can act on. A visitor to the homepage can calculate earning potential for a property.

The homepage claims thousands of hosts and investors as its audience. AirDNA says its leadership team has worked since 2015 on helping customers price, optimize, and invest in short-term vacation rental properties. The about page credits founder Scott with starting AirDNA to help entrepreneurs make the most of the short-term rental market. Corporate headquarters is in downtown Denver.
